ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a probability histogram of the discrete random variable X, and the values on the horizontal axis are 2, 3, 4, 5; from the heights of the bars, one can read P(X=2)=0.3, P(X=3)=0.2, P(X=4)=0.4, P(X=5)=0.1. Then reason: the problem asks for μ_x, that is, the mean/expectation of the random variable X. According to the formula μ_x=E[X]=ΣxP(X=x), the calculation is 2(0.3)+3(0.2)+4(0.4)+5(0.1)=0.6+0.6+1.6+0.5=3.3.
